description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 4730015951421 CONNECTOR,HYDRAULIC: Line 0001 Qty 48 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0147 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). The Guaranteed Minimum quantity will be 7. Items will be shipped to various CONUS and OCONUS (via consolidation and containerization point) DLA Depots. Approved source is 56529 24322-100. All responsible sources may submit a quote which, if timely received, shall be considered. Quotes must be submitted electronically.
